author: Jennifer Eggleston
title: Things To Do in Augusta This Weekend: June 26-June 28 - NewsBreak
text:
By Jennifer Eggleston ,
12 hours ago This week's Augusta event lineup includes something for everyone, from large-scale festivals to intimate community gatherings. The 16th annual Augusta Pride Festival kicks off Pride Weekend with music and vendors at its new fairgrounds home. Music lovers can catch the third annual Build the Band, a charity showdown benefiting Habitat for Humanity, while toy and comic enthusiasts will want to check out JoeFest's massive convention. Round out the weekend with a faith gathering, storytelling, and nightlife, then enjoy food, games, and family-friendly fun in the week heading into July. Read full article
